before.name: Aluminiumtape Cold Weather
before.description: Aluminiumtape met sterke kleefkracht voor koude en warme toepassingen. Bron TPS Pack webshop. Verpakkingsopties: 50 mm x 45 m (24 rollen) 87 euro; 50 mm x 50 m (24 rollen), 75 mm x 50 m (16 rollen), 100 mm x 50 m (16 rollen) elk 96 euro per verpakking, inclusief btw volgens bron.

after.name: Aluminium Tape – Cold Weather
after.description: Suitable for sealing insulation blankets, spiral ducts and flue gas ducts. Features strong adhesion, a cold-weather acrylic adhesive and DIN 4102 B1 classification. Available pack sizes: 50 mm × 45 m (24 rolls), 50 mm × 50 m (24 rolls), 75 mm × 50 m (16 rolls) and 100 mm × 50 m (16 rolls).
after.short_description: Vapour-tight aluminium tape with cold-weather acrylic adhesive for insulation and sealing.

before.name: ISOHULK Aluminiumtape AW IMO
before.description: Premium aluminiumtape met IMO-stuurwielcertificaat, sterke kleefkracht en koudweerbestendige belijming. Maten en verpakkingsaantallen afkomstig van tpspack.nl/webshop/. Actuele prijzen en bestelbaarheid nog te controleren.
before.short_description: Premium aluminiumtape met IMO-stuurwielcertificaat, sterke kleefkracht en koudweerbestendige belijming.

after.name: ISOHULK Aluminium Tape AW IMO
after.description: Designed for demanding marine insulation and sealing applications. Flame-retardant aluminium tape with aggressive cold-weather adhesive; TPS Pack states temperature resistance from −40°C to +140°C. Available in 50 mm × 50 m (24 rolls), 75 mm × 50 m (16 rolls) and 100 mm × 50 m (12 rolls).
after.short_description: IMO/MED-certified premium aluminium tape with strong cold-weather adhesion.

before.name: ISOHULK Aluminium Tracing Tape IMO
before.description: Glasvezelversterkte aluminiumtape met IMO-stuurwielcertificaat en krachtige kleeflaag. Maten en verpakkingsaantallen afkomstig van tpspack.nl/webshop/. Actuele prijzen en bestelbaarheid nog te controleren.
before.short_description: Glasvezelversterkte aluminiumtape met IMO-stuurwielcertificaat en krachtige kleeflaag.

after.name: ISOHULK Aluminium Tracing Tape IMO
after.description: Glass-fibre-reinforced aluminium tape described by TPS Pack as IMO/MED-certified for marine use. Available in 50 mm × 50 m, 75 mm × 50 m and 100 mm × 50 m formats. Confirm current pack quantities before ordering.
after.short_description: Marine-grade, glass-fibre-reinforced aluminium tracing tape with strong adhesion.

before.name: Aluminium Butyl Reparatietape

before.short_description: Waterbestendige butyltape voor afdichten van naden, aansluitingen en voegen.

after.name: Aluminium Butyl Waterproof Repair Tape

after.short_description: Water-resistant and vapour-tight butyl repair tape for sealing joints and connections.

after.description: Premium polypropylene-aluminium tape with an aluminium coating, suitable for use in both cool and warm conditions. after.short_description: Black cold-weather aluminium tape for a neat finish on dark insulation.
